screens.title: Treating doctors
screens.purpose: Who looks after each inpatient, the Code Reds waiting for a doctor, and reassigning a patient while the treating doctor is away.

tasks.summary: The live admissions and their treating doctors
An inpatient's treating doctor and every change of it
Hand an inpatient over to another doctor
Find a staff member for a form (badge facts only)

rules: One row per live admission: the patient, MRN, ward and bed, the treating doctor and since when; the Code Reds waiting for a doctor first, in amber. Filter by doctor (doctor_id) to see a doctor's patients before their leave. No clinical record here: never show a diagnosis.

Reassign: the doctor (GET /staff/lookup?license_type=PMDC) and the reason (required: the medico-legal record), then POST /admissions/{admission_id}/treating-doctor with an Idempotency-Key. It takes effect at once and both doctors are told (admission.doctor_changed). VALIDATION_ERROR (details.field doctor_id): not a registered doctor, or already the treating doctor.
A row opens its history (GET /admissions/{admission_id}/treating-doctor: changes, oldest first: who, when, kind TakeOver, Handover or Reassigned, the reason).

screens.title: Owner dashboard
screens.purpose: Live P&L flash, trend, visited vs examined.

tasks.summary: Live P&L flash (today by default): income streams vs overheads
Daily net income vs expenses for a chart (max 92 days)
"Visited" (tickets sold) vs "Examined" per doctor and hospital-wide
Trial balance

rules: Refresh every 60 s while visible; figures are live from the ledger.

screens.title: Holiday calendar
screens.purpose: Keep the year's public holidays (HR and the Hospital Admin share this calendar).

tasks.summary: Public holidays of a year (or a date range)

rules: A year view: enter the gazetted list at once (POST /holidays is all or nothing; HOLIDAY_DATE_TAKEN names details.entry_index). The Eids move every year: nothing recurs.
Fixed-schedule staff are off on a holiday (flag Holiday, paid); rostered staff work as rostered.
Never delete: withdraw with is_active false (send row_version as expected_version). Changing today or a past day recomputes its attendance; a payroll run already generated is not changed.

screens.title: Risk & compliance
screens.purpose: Heuristic findings for human review (not accusations).

tasks.summary: Open findings by rule and severity (heuristic scores, for human review)
Flagged-for-review list (not accusations)
Record the human review outcome
Risk rules (thresholds live in /admin/settings risk_* keys)
Audit trail (filterable)

rules: Word it as 'flagged for review'. Critical (e.g. VOIDED_BUT_EXAMINED) pops a notification.

screens.title: Medical record review (MSDS)
screens.purpose: The quarterly medical record review: plan and follow cycles, read the surveyor's report.

tasks.summary: Review schedule at a glance (what is due, what is open, MSDS 156)
Review cycles (newest period first)
Plan a review cycle
A cycle with its panel, sampled records, deficiency counts and actions
Who can review records or own an action
Replace the review panel
The sampling plan (a preview before the start; nothing is drawn)
Draw the sample and start the review
Hand a pending record to another panel member
A sampled record with its checklist and the system's answers
Close the cycle with the minutes
Cancel a cycle
The surveyor's report, with the MSDS 156-162 ratings
The surveyor's report as a PDF
Record deficiencies (mine: to fix, or raised by me)
Resolve a deficiency
Record a corrective or preventive action
The action register (mine: the actions I own)
Close an action: done with the evidence, or cancelled
The review checklist
Add a checklist item of the hospital's own
Reword, reorder or retire a checklist item
Departments

rules: Start from GET /quality/record-review/status: `next_due` names the period to review (a quarter by default); 'Plan review' pre-fills it (POST /quality/record-reviews with no period).
Panel picker = GET /quality/record-review/people (can_review). Show each reviewer's discipline: MSDS 158 wants doctors AND nurses, never only the records staff.

Before 'Start', show GET .../sample-plan as a table (department x state: population, sample) with the formula line; after the start the sample and period are frozen (say so on the button's confirmation).
Progress bar per reviewer (reviewers[].assigned / reviewed), live with record_review.updated. Records with no reviewer (everyone on the panel wrote in them) need 'Assign' to a new panel member.
'Close' asks for the minutes. Show the three refusals as a checklist before enabling it: all reviewed, no open deficiency, an action recorded when deficiencies were found.
The report is the surveyor's evidence: print it (A4). Put the MSDS block first: one row per indicator 156-162 with Met (green) / PartlyMet (amber) / NotMet (red) and the evidence text.
Records appear by record number and MRN only; never add patient names to this screen or its printout.
'Print' = GET .../report/pdf (A4, the MSDS block first); it is also the record_review_report of the inspection pack.
Deficiencies: Acknowledge (true but cannot be undone, e.g. a late note) or Withdraw (not a deficiency); authors mark their own Corrected from their workspace.
Actions: type, owner (GET /quality/record-review/people), due date; they join the hospital's action register (GET /quality/actions?source=RecordReview); overdue ones in red (is_overdue).
Checklist editor: built-in items (auto_check set) can be reworded or retired, not deleted; the hospital's own items are answered by the reviewer.

screens.title: Death register & mortality
screens.purpose: The death register, the month's mortality statistics and the deaths to review; authorize clinical autopsies.

tasks.summary: The death register
Mortality statistics for a period
A death record with its certificate
Authorize the clinical autopsy: non-medico-legal certificate, consent, order to the prosector
Cancel the autopsy request
Printable death certificate, or the order for a clinical autopsy
The death certificate or the autopsy order as a PDF

rules: Statistics default to this month (date_from / date_to to change): tiles for gross and net death rates, deaths within 24 / 48 hours of admission, post-operative deaths, deaths within 48 hours of an operation (the anaesthesia screen), maternal, neonatal, brought dead, medico-legal; tables by setting, manner, department and the top underlying causes (ICD categories, with their titles).
review_list is the mortality meeting's agenda (unexpected and maternal deaths are sentinel events, MSDS 106): each opens the death record.

An autopsy request (notification category autopsy_request) waits here: 'Authorize' certifies the death is not medico-legal, records the next of kin's consent (name, relationship, what was agreed) and names the prosector; the doctor who asked cannot authorize it (AUTOPSY_SELF_AUTHORIZED).
